code_state: working tree implementation; harness records final commit

split.session_assignment: first start_ms week; identity=(public week, session_id)
split.target_boundary: end_ms < next split start; missing end excluded; history unchanged

model_settings.selection: original-scale holdout q pinball; first grid candidate on tie
model_settings.vocabulary: fit_target for selection, train_target for refit; unknown/missing -> NA
model_settings.crossing: sort each row after original-scale inverse transform

B_minus_L.ci: 95% percentile, linear interpolation; predictor minus reference
B_minus_L.empty_group_draws: omit and report valid_replicates per group
